**Interpreting visual actions**

I need to interpret the main concepts related to eye and head/neck actions. It seems like “look” or “see” would fit. For H14, it’s about use/action, and C14 focuses on sight/eye, while C11 relates to head/face/neck. I’m thinking about verbs like “watching” or “looking.” My best guesses for the main concept would be “eyeball,” “look at,” or the actions: “looking,” “seeing,” or “watching.”
